test_title: PYST 33: SSC CHSL - Reasoning (Held On: 21 March, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
A cube in made by folding the given sheet. In the cube so found, which letter will be on the face opposite to the face showing 'F'?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ffb1c9a9453986ab3c0206c64956fed1a878ccd3d4e78018150774ca3574107f.png]
solution:
From the given open Dice:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/05f82e943b72612b654b7bd3e62507bffed27cae7eebd2e242333175f6a392da.png] 

R and D is the opposite sides.

C and G is the opposite sides.

F and M is the opposite sides.

So, the face of 'F' is opposite to the face showing 'M'.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
